info.title: ASA Server Manager API
info.description: REST API for managing ARK: Survival Ascended Server instances

get.summary: List all instances with basic configuration
get.description: Returns a list of all server instances including their running status and basic configuration information

post.summary: Create a backup of instance world

post.description: Restores a backup file to a server instance. If the instance does not exist, it will be created automatically. You can selectively restore components using the optional parameters. Defaults to restoring all components (worldfile, instance config, and game config).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Instance name (will be created if it doesn't exist)

post.summary: Update ARK server with real-time progress
post.description: Downloads and updates the ARK server files using SteamCMD. Returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream with real-time progress updates.

200.description: Update in progress - returns SSE stream with progress messages

put.summary: Update Game.ini content directly via text

post.summary: Synchronize game config files from base server to instances
post.description: Syncs Game.ini and GameUserSettings.ini files from the base server directory to instance Config folders. Only updates entries that don't exist in the instance configuration files, preserving existing instance-specific settings.

post.summary: Sync instance configuration and files from source to multiple target instances
post.description: Synchronizes instance configuration (ModIDs, CustomStartParameters, ServerPassword, ServerAdminPassword, EnableAsaPlugin) and entire Config folder from a source instance to multiple target instances. Target instances keep their other configuration fields (ServerName, Port, RCONPort, QueryPort, MaxPlayers, MapName, SaveDir, ClusterID) intact.

put.summary: Update GameUserSettings.ini content directly via text

get.summary: WebSocket connection for real-time server events
get.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to receive real-time broadcast events for all server instances. Client should send a ClientMessage with client_id on connection. All connected clients receive the same events globally.

101.description: Switching Protocols - WebSocket connection established and ready to receive events

get.summary: WebSocket connection for RCON command execution
get.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for interactive RCON command execution. Each command is executed independently with a temporary RCON connection to the specified instance. No persistent connection state is maintained.

101.description: Switching Protocols - WebSocket connection established for RCON commands

running.description: Whether the server instance is currently running

world_folder.description: Name of the world folder to backup

restore_worldfile.description: Restore worldfile (SaveDir content). Defaults to true

restore_instance_config.description: Restore instance_config.ini file. Defaults to true

restore_game_config.description: Restore game config files (Config directory). Defaults to true

MapName.description: Name of the map to use

EnableAsaPlugin.description: Whether ASA plugins are enabled for the server

MapName.description: Name of the map to use

EnableAsaPlugin.description: Whether ASA plugins are enabled for the server

SyncConfigRequest.description: Request to synchronize game config files to instances

instances.description: List of instance names to sync configuration to

SyncInstanceConfigRequest.description: Request to sync instance configuration and Config folder from source to multiple target instances

source_instance.description: Name of the source instance to sync from

target_instances.description: List of target instance names to sync to

synced_instances.description: List of successfully synced target instances

instance.description: Instance name that failed to sync

failed_instances.description: List of instances that failed to sync with error details

failure_count.description: Number of instances that failed to sync

count.description: Total number of successfully synced instances

filename.description: Name of the updated configuration file

ClientMessage.description: Message sent from WebSocket client to server (for heartbeat, connection identification, etc.)

client_id.description: Unique client identifier provided by the client

ServerUpdateSSEStream.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time server update progress

data.description: Progress message from the update process

update_ark_server.value: data: Downloading and updating ARK server files...

ServerEvent.description: Server event message sent via WebSocket (global broadcast to all connected clients)

instance_name.description: Name of the server instance that triggered the event (empty for connection event)

RCONMessage.description: Message sent from WebSocket client to server for RCON operations

instance_name.description: Name of the instance (required for command action)

command.description: RCON command to execute (required for command action)

response.description: RCON command execution response (for command action)
